    Basic algebras: idempotents and a nilpotent radical #

    BasicData k A records a complete set of orthogonal idempotents e v and a nilpotent two-sided ideal R such that A = ⊕ k e_v ⊕ R. Every corner e_i a e_j with i ≠ j lies in R, and e_i a e_i is a scalar plus an element of R (corner). A scalar plus an element of R is a unit (isUnit_add), and Nakayama's lemma holds for ideals (le_of_le_sup).

    Type u_2

    Orthogonal idempotents complemented by a nilpotent two-sided ideal.

    • n : ℕ
    • e : Fin self.n → A
    • e_mul_e (v w : Fin self.n) : self.e v * self.e w = if v = w then self.e v else 0
    • sum_e : ∑ v : Fin self.n, self.e v = 1
    • R : Submodule k A
    • mul_mem_left (a r : A) : r ∈ self.R → a * r ∈ self.R
    • mul_mem_right (r a : A) : r ∈ self.R → r * a ∈ self.R
    • pow_eq_bot : ∃ (N : ℕ), self.R ^ N = ⊥
    • decomp (a : A) : ∃ (c : Fin self.n → k), a - ∑ v : Fin self.n, c v • self.e v ∈ self.R
    • e_not_mem (v : Fin self.n) : self.e v ∉ self.R

      theorem BrickAccessibility.SkowWasch.BasicData.corner {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] (B : BasicData k A) (i : Fin B.n) (a : A) :
